text: Large barricades bisect the corridor, scorched by weapons fire.
Bodies litter the ground on either side.
Documents are scattered down the hall, most charred and curled.
This one looks interesting.
The next door leads to a ransacked planning room.
Maps of the surface can still be found among the debris.
Scavenge maps
Drew some attention with all that noise.
Slipped past an automated sentry.
If only they'd been destroyed along with everything else.
Ran straight into another one.
The corridor passes through a security checkpoint. The defenses are blown apart, their ragged edges scorched by laser fire.
Past the checkpoint, banks of containment cells come into view.
The cells are all empty.
Power cables running across the ceiling are split in several places, sparking occasionally.
The guards died at their posts, shot through with superheated plasma.
Their weapons lie on the floor beside them.
The corridor opens onto a vast training complex, its obstacles and features blackened by real combat.
A regenerative machine hums uncannily beside one of the courses.
Movement from the center of the yard.
A sparring automaton, still fully functional and crusted with timeworn blood, lunges forward.
Engage
The machine attacks, blades whirling.
Murderous robot
The ruins of the sparring machine clatter to the ground.
Picked this deck clean.
Medical Wing
The elevator doors open onto an empty corridor.
A few dusty corpses lie farther down, but this deck appears to have been spared most of the combat.
Past the checkpoint, the corridor is undamaged save for sporadic graffiti.
There was no fighting here.
Automated guardians still stalk the halls, unaware that their masters have long since gone.
Clumsy machines, easily avoided.
Medical gurneys are fixed to grooves running down the corridor walls.
The automated patient transport system now sits motionless.
It had friends.
More medical robots stand frozen, connected by a network of wires.
They take no notice of the intrusion.
Weapons are strewn about the medical dispatch bay. It must have been used as a muster point.
More strange graffiti adorns the walls.
This ward has been converted into a makeshift strategy room, with maps hastily scrawled on every flat surface.
A secure locker is set into one wall.
Force locker
The hinges have rusted through. No challenge.
The noise draws attention.
Better to move without drawing attention.
Noises can be heard from the corridor outside.
Something's wrong with this robot.
Unstable automaton
Another checkpoint ahead, fitted with heavy doors.
Security is even tighter here.
Slipped through unnoticed.
Air whistles as the doors open. This section must be at lower pressure than the rest of the ship.
The air is cooler here. Low cabinets line the room, their doors dusted with frost.
Samples of something biological inside.
Security drones still patrol the hallways.
Predictable paths.
Surgical tools are scattered on the floor near what appears to be the remains of a fire.
Strange.
The air in this room has a metallic tinge. The floor is covered in dark powder.
